messages.msg_0738_UNION_00162:
You may communicate with other
players and mix your records.What will happen if you mix records,
you ask?We recommend that you try it and
see!Up to five players can take part,
so try it with your friends!
messages.msg_0738_UNION_00163:
In a Spin Trade, participants each bring
an Egg for trading with others.Which Egg will you end up with?
What kind of Pokémon is in that Egg? It’s quite exciting and fun!Up to five players can take part, so
try it with your friends!
